messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's hairstyle to match the reference images. Match the shape and styling of the hair in the reference images, while retaining the current person's facial features, hair color, and clothing. Leave the rest of the video unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please select the video where the person has black hair, then use that video as the starting point for the following change: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's hairstyle to match the reference images. Match the shape and styling of the hair in the reference images, while retaining the current person's facial features, hair color, and clothing. Leave the rest of the video unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"He stands facing the camera, then raises his arms and performs a few dance-like movements before returning to a standing pose.","camera":"Static medium-full shot at eye level, centered on the character.","clothing":"White sleeveless tank top with a pink palm-tree graphic and 'Los Angeles' text, pink shorts, and pink slip-on shoes.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Short hair with a small top-knot bun at the crown.","identity":"A 3D-rendered young Black man with a slim build and short facial hair.","scene":"A cobblestone street in a European-style town with stone buildings, black lampposts, bollards, and a Union Jack flag hanging in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's short curly hair was replaced with a slicked-back style featuring a small top-knot bun at the crown, matching the reference shape. Clothing, scene, camera, and dance-like movements remained largely the same.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's hairstyle to match the reference images, preserving facial features, black hair color, and clothing while leaving the rest of the video unchanged.
uncertain: Whether the hairstyle fully matches the reference from all angles, since the video is mostly front-facing and the reference includes a back view.
unexpected_changes: The character's face appears somewhat smoother and less detailed in the output, though identity and facial features remain broadly consistent.
